description: Scout connector telemetry, session-token accounting and the restrict_tools MCP gate. Activate only inside scheduled scout runs (each hook short-circuits when SCOUT_MODE is unset; the PreToolUse gate also skips Python unless the vault's connectors.custom.yaml uses restrict_tools). Per #72, per-tool-call accounting was moved out of PostToolUse (which fired one Python cold-start per tool call) into the session-tool-log Stop hook that walks the transcript once at session end.

hooks.command: [ -n "$SCOUT_MODE" ] || exit 0; grep -qs restrict_tools "${SCOUT_DATA_DIR:-$HOME/Scout}/connectors.custom.yaml" || exit 0; exec "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/engine/bin/scoutctl" hook mcp-tool-gate
